item.title: [keras] Keras: HDF5 links can disclose local file contents | Security Advisory for Python packages hosted at PyPI.org
item.description: A vulnerability in keras-team/keras versions &lt;= 3.14.0 allows arbitrary local HDF5 file content disclosure due to improper handling of HDF5 ExternalLinks. The KerasFileEditor and keras.saving.load_wei
item.content:encoded: A vulnerability in keras-team/keras versions &lt;= 3.14.0 allows arbitrary local HDF5 file content disclosure due to improper handling of HDF5 ExternalLinks. The KerasFileEditor and keras.saving.load_weights functions bypass the safe_get_h5_group and safe_get_h5_dataset helpers, which are designed to reject ExternalLinks and SoftLinks.
